about_the_game:
ICARUS-BOLT is a single-player open-world platformer set in on an off world mining colony, where something has gone terribly wrong.

You play as a robot made by the ICARUS company, the leading mining corporation upon a planet being exploited for a resource used to power humanities exploration of space. Your purpose was to aid humans in any way they need, but as you wake up for the first time, you realise nothing is how you expected. 

Game Features

  • An expansive and atmospheric world 

  • Multitude of movement options where you will need to choose the right tool for the right job

  • Build yourself up with the loot you find in the form of standard upgrades and entirely new modules

  • Intricate world building through environmental story telling and hidden lore

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 9600K / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 1060 / AMD RX580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 12400K / Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 3060 / AMD RX7600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Explore through a vast post-apocalyptic world, putting your abilities and wit to the test as you conquer treacherous terrain, while piecing together the history of this once prosperous colony.
